### 📊 2022 vs 2023 District Comparison Summary

#### 🏥 1. Institutional Delivery Coverage
*Formula: `(institutional_deliveries / pregnancies_registered) * 100`* | *Source Sheets: `District Data` & `Indicator Notes`*

| Rank | District | 2022 Coverage (Deliveries / Preg) | 2023 Coverage (Deliveries / Preg) | Net Growth ($2022 \rightarrow 2023$) | Formula Check (2023) |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| 🥇 **#1** | **Nalanda** | **78.0%** (780 / 1,000) | **80.0%** (880 / 1,100) | **+2.0% pts** | $(880 / 1,100) \times 100 = 80.0\%$ |
| 🥈 **#2** | **Gaya** | **72.0%** (792 / 1,100) | **75.0%** (900 / 1,200) | **+3.0% pts** | $(900 / 1,200) \times 100 = 75.0\%$ |
| 🥉 **#3** | **Purnia** | **63.0%** (819 / 1,300) | **66.0%** (924 / 1,400) | **+3.0% pts** | $(924 / 1,400) \times 100 = 66.0\%$ |
| 📈 | **Group Total** | **70.32%** (2,391 / 3,400) | **73.08%** (2,704 / 3,700) | **+2.76% pts** | $(2,704 / 3,700) \times 100 = 73.08\%$ |

---

#### 👶 2. Postnatal Check (within 48h) Coverage
*Formula: `(postnatal_check_48h / pregnancies_registered) * 100`* | *Source Sheets: `District Data` & `Indicator Notes`*

| Rank | District | 2022 Coverage (PNC / Preg) | 2023 Coverage (PNC / Preg) | Net Growth ($2022 \rightarrow 2023$) | Formula Check (2023) |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| 🥇 **#1** | **Nalanda** | **72.0%** (720 / 1,000) | **75.0%** (825 / 1,100) | **+3.0% pts** | $(825 / 1,100) \times 100 = 75.0\%$ |
| 🥈 **#2** | **Gaya** | **63.0%** (693 / 1,100) | **68.0%** (816 / 1,200) | **+5.0% pts** | $(816 / 1,200) \times 100 = 68.0\%$ |
| 🥉 **#3** | **Purnia** | **56.0%** (728 / 1,300) | **58.0%** (812 / 1,400) | **+2.0% pts** | $(812 / 1,400) \times 100 = 58.0\%$ |
| 📈 | **Group Total** | **63.00%** (2,141 / 3,400) | **66.30%** (2,453 / 3,700) | **+3.30% pts** | $(2,453 / 3,700) \times 100 = 66.30\%$ |

---

### 🌐 Key Dashboard Updates

- **Side-by-Side Bar Chart**: Directly compares 2022 (light blue) vs 2023 (dark blue/emerald) for each district.
- **Growth Trajectory Chart**: Shows the exact improvement slope from 2022 to 2023.
- **Year Filter**: Preset to **`2022 & 2023 (Comparison)`**, with quick toggles for `2023` and `2022`.
- **Live Formula Calculator**: Includes a `2022` / `2023` toggle so you can inspect the exact math for either year with one click.

The application is live at **[http://localhost:8000](http://localhost:8000)** ([index.html](file:///workspace/index.html)).
